full_sentence: Although the exercise was difficult, I still think it was useful for my English.

options.why_wrong: 'So' shows a result, not a contrast. After 'although', the sentence needs a clause that contrasts with the first part.

options.text: I was tired because of the noise.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a cause. It does not show contrast, so it does not complete the 'although' structure.

options.text: I still think it was useful for my English.

options.why_wrong: This adds a time detail but does not express the contrast expected after 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', we need a clause that shows contrast with the first part of the sentence. Learners often pick a result clause with 'so' because the same idea works in other languages with a cause-and-effect structure.
